final: WITH media_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, COUNT(*) as track_count, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) as bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804 AND Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_bytes_per_ms_across_types, AVG(track_count) as avg_track_count_across_types FROM media_stats
